The Evening Oncology Staff Pharmacist 2 position focuses on oncology patient care in the inpatient medical oncology setting and infusion settings. The Evening Oncology pharmacist provides alternating evening and day shift oncology pharmacy shifts with weekend and holiday rotation, as needed, to meet the needs of the inpatient oncology and infusion service lines.

The 8Rx pharmacy provides medications for adult and pediatric pediatric oncology patients. The Evening Oncology Pharmacist oversees order review, verification and preparation of hazardous and non-hazardous medications for hospitalized patients on the inpatient oncology and hospital infusion service lines. The Evening Oncology pharmacist works directly with pharmacy technicians to oversee accuracy of product preparation and compliance with regulatory requirements. #CA-DS
Completion of Post Graduate Year Two (PGY2) Oncology Pharmacy Residency
